blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The University of the Philippines (UP) Manila emerged as the Philippines’ lone representative in the global Top 500 of the U.S. News & World Report’s 2026-2027 Best Global Universities rankings. The country’s premier health sciences university rose 32 places from its previous ranking of No. 479 to No. 447 among 2,250 universities evaluated by U.S. News & World Report. UP Manila said Monday that it “joined other universities that entered the roster of the best universities in the world, including Stanford University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Princeton University, and Harvard University, among others.” UP Manila ranked first in normalized […]...
